intent: Give the new signal-bot phone app (~/signal-bot/app) a launcher icon from the shared family, so it stops shipping the stock Flutter beach icon.
scope: python_pkg/app_icons/glyphs.py - register the glyph in GLYPHS
python_pkg/app_icons/apps.py - register the app so --app signalbot_remote passes argument validation
Non-goal: no change to the shared accent #B8862E or the charcoal field; a glyph is distinguished by silhouette only
Non-goal: no change to any existing app's icon
Non-goal: the app itself, its Flutter code and its Cloudflare transport all live in ~/signal-bot and are committed there
changes: Added _REMOTE_WAVE: a filled handset (x=412..612, y=440..792, r=56) with two punched-out buttons (r=40 at 512,540 and 512,680) under a detached stroked arc (r=132 about 512,440, drawn 135deg to 45deg). Total ink y=272..792, x=383..641, inside the 560 safe box.
The arc is detached from the body on purpose: an arc that meets the body is a padlock shackle, and padlock-closed is already in this family.
The body is filled rather than stroked, for the same reason as _QUILL_NIB and _ANVIL: a 200-wide stroked body leaves a 56px interior at STROKE_WIDTH=72 and fills in solid at 48dp.
Registered Glyph('remote-wave', ...) in GLYPHS and AppIcon(key='signalbot_remote', glyph='remote-wave', linux=False) in APPS, pointing at ~/signal-bot/app.

verification.evidence: remote-wave appears under Glyphs; 'signalbot_remote #B8862E remote-wave /home/kuhy/signal-bot/app' appears under Apps.

wrote 6 asset files to /home/kuhy/signal-bot/app/assets/icon and regenerated the Android mipmaps. The generator's safe-box and negative-space checks did not fire. A first attempt failed because flutter_launcher_icons was not yet in the app's pubspec; the config block was added and it then succeeded.

verification.command: visual review of the rendered preview sheet (full size, circle-masked, 48dp)
verification.evidence: Reads as a handset with a signal arc at all three sizes. The two buttons stay separate at 48dp (60px edge gap against MIN_NEGATIVE_SPACE=36) and the arc keeps it from reading as a domino.

44 passed; python_pkg/app_icons at 100% line and branch coverage. The registry invariants (every app references a real glyph, accents are shared, no glyph paints the background) iterate over APPS and GLYPHS, so the new entries are exercised by the existing tests.

risks: The glyph is new artwork, so only a visual check can confirm it reads correctly at 48dp. Mitigated by rendering and reviewing the actual preview sheet rather than trusting the SVG source.
Not yet verified on the phone: kuhy's device is unavailable until 2026-09-10, so the launcher has not rendered this icon on real hardware.
_glyph_art_more.py is now 160 lines. Together with _glyph_art.py it exists solely to stay under the 250-line cap, so a third file will be needed before long.
rollback: git revert the commit. The three edits are additive - no existing glyph, app or shared token is touched - so a revert cannot change any other app's icon.

After rollback, re-run 'python3 -m python_pkg.app_icons list' and confirm the remaining 16 glyphs still resolve. The already-generated PNGs in ~/signal-bot/app would then have no source in this repo, so revert that repo's icon commit too or regenerate from a restored glyph.
